records.title_en: Direct and indirect sets are not identical dose units
records.title_zh: 直接组与间接组不是完全相同的剂量单位
records.population: Predominantly young healthy adults in resistance-training studies.
records.summary_zh: 复合动作对多个肌群有贡献，但不能把每个参与肌群都机械地记为一整组直接训练。训练量统计需要说明采用直接、全部还是折算计数。
records.technical_summary_en: Meta-regression fit was sensitive to how direct and indirect sets were counted, with fractional counting receiving the strongest relative support.
records.limitations: Set-credit models remain analytical approximations and do not measure individual muscle stimulus.

records.title_en: Resistance-training volume has diminishing returns
records.title_zh: 抗阻训练量存在边际收益递减
records.population: Healthy adults represented in resistance-training reviews.
records.summary_zh: 增加周训练组数通常与更多力量或肌肉适应相关，但增加到后面，每多一组带来的平均收益会变小。更多并不自动等于更适合个人。
records.technical_summary_en: Positive volume slopes were observed for strength and hypertrophy, while best-fit models indicated diminishing returns, especially for strength.
records.limitations: Group-level curves cannot identify an individual's optimal or tolerable volume.

records.title_en: Frequency is not the same as weekly dose
records.title_zh: 训练频率不等于周训练剂量
records.population: Healthy adults in resistance-training frequency studies.
records.summary_zh: 频率描述一周练几次，训练量描述完成了多少有效工作。提高频率常用于分配训练量或增加动作练习机会，不能单独当作增肌剂量。
records.technical_summary_en: Frequency showed a clearer independent association with strength than hypertrophy; volume-equated hypertrophy effects are generally small or uncertain.
records.limitations: Frequency effects remain difficult to separate from volume, skill practice and recovery distribution.

records.title_en: The whole prescription matters more than one variable
records.title_zh: 完整处方比单个训练变量更重要
records.population: Healthy adults undertaking resistance training.
records.summary_zh: 抗阻训练本身对力量和肌肉量的作用较稳定，但不少单一变量，如固定节奏、某一种周期化或某个休息秒数，并没有足够证据成为普适最优答案。
records.technical_summary_en: The umbrella review found robust effects of resistance training while evidence for superiority of several isolated prescription variables was insufficient.
records.limitations: Review overlap and uneven evidence quality limit certainty for specific variables and physical-function outcomes.

records.title_en: Periodization can organize strength development
records.title_zh: 周期化可以组织力量发展
records.population: Healthy trained and untrained adults in volume-equated studies.
records.summary_zh: 在总训练量相当时，有计划地改变训练量和强度可能比长期不变更有利于 1RM 力量，优势在已有训练经验的人群中更明显。
records.technical_summary_en: Volume-equated periodized training produced a small pooled 1RM advantage over non-periodized training, with stronger subgroup effects in trained participants.
records.limitations: Results do not establish one best periodization model or apply equally to beginners.

records.title_en: Periodization is not a separate hypertrophy stimulus
records.title_zh: 周期化不是额外的增肌刺激
records.population: Healthy adults in resistance-training interventions.
records.summary_zh: 当总训练量相当时，现有综述没有发现周期化本身带来更大的肌肥大。它更像组织负荷与训练阶段的方法，而不是独立的增肌因子。
records.technical_summary_en: Pooled hypertrophy outcomes did not differ between periodized and non-periodized or linear and undulating programs when volume was equated.
records.limitations: Hypertrophy studies were fewer than strength studies and other periodization models remain understudied.

records.title_en: Rest intervals should preserve the intended work
records.title_zh: 组间休息应服务于目标训练质量
records.population: Healthy adults training for hypertrophy.
records.summary_zh: 短休息和长休息都可能增肌。超过 60 秒可能有小幅优势，部分原因是能维持后续组的完成质量，但证据不支持把某个秒数设成所有动作的唯一答案。
records.technical_summary_en: Bayesian estimates overlapped substantially; central estimates suggested a small benefit above 60 seconds and little detectable added hypertrophy above about 90 seconds.
records.limitations: Only nine heterogeneous studies were included; strength, power and time-efficiency goals require separate interpretation.

records.title_en: No single repetition tempo maximizes hypertrophy
records.title_zh: 没有一种动作节奏能普遍最大化增肌
records.population: Healthy people in dynamic resistance-training studies.
records.summary_zh: 约 0.5 到 8 秒一次的多种受控节奏都能产生肌肥大。故意做得极慢没有被证明更好，节奏更适合用来约束技术和动作意图。
records.technical_summary_en: Hypertrophy outcomes were similar across a broad 0.5-8 second repetition-duration range in eight eligible studies.
records.limitations: Most protocols trained to failure; findings do not define power-training tempo or every exercise phase.

records.title_en: Velocity loss is a set-level fatigue signal
records.title_zh: 速度损失是组内疲劳信号
records.population: Mostly trained adults using velocity-measurement devices.
records.summary_zh: 同一组内速度下降通常伴随重复次数、代谢和主观负担增加。它可以帮助统一何时结束一组，但前提是设备、动作和负荷条件一致。
records.technical_summary_en: Greater velocity loss was generally associated with more repetitions, lactate, RPE and acute neuromuscular decrement.
records.limitations: Velocity loss is exercise- and load-specific and cannot be inferred reliably without a valid measurement device.

records.title_en: Velocity-loss thresholds involve adaptation tradeoffs
records.title_zh: 速度损失阈值存在适应目标权衡
records.population: Trained adults in velocity-based resistance-training studies.
records.summary_zh: 更高的速度损失意味着组内做得更深，可能增加肌肥大刺激，但也可能不利于跳跃、冲刺和亚最大负荷速度表现。没有一个阈值同时最适合所有目标。
records.technical_summary_en: Higher velocity-loss thresholds were associated with more hypertrophy but less favorable jump, sprint and submaximal-velocity adaptations, while strength differences were less clear.
records.limitations: Findings are concentrated in trained populations and vary by exercise, device and load.

records.title_en: Autoregulation is an option, not an automatic upgrade
records.title_zh: 自我调节是一种方法，不是自动升级
records.population: Resistance-trained people in short intervention studies.
records.summary_zh: 用 RPE、RIR 或速度反馈调整当天负荷是可行方法，但现有证据没有显示它在所有情况下都稳定优于设计合理的固定百分比方案。
records.technical_summary_en: Pooled 1RM differences between autoregulated and standardized load prescription were small and not statistically clear.
records.limitations: Studies were few and short, and experienced trainees dominated the evidence.

records.title_en: Velocity feedback requires valid measurement
records.title_zh: 速度反馈必须建立在有效测量上
records.population: Apparently healthy and trained participants in velocity-based training studies.
records.summary_zh: VBT 的逻辑依赖可靠的速度测量。没有经过验证的设备与固定协议，不能把主观观察或普通手机估算当作研究中的速度阈值。
records.technical_summary_en: Velocity-based trials used measured feedback; comparative evidence was small and low quality, with no clear superiority over traditional training.
records.limitations: The reviewed evidence does not validate SportRX phone-based velocity measurement or automated load decisions.

records.title_en: Endurance intensity distribution has several valid models
records.title_zh: 耐力训练强度分布存在多种有效模型
records.population: Recreational to highly trained endurance athletes.
records.summary_zh: 极化、金字塔和其他强度分布都能改善耐力表现。研究比较的是一段时间内各强度区间如何组合，不是把每一节课都做成同一种强度。
records.technical_summary_en: Comparative interventions support multiple effective training-intensity distributions with outcome- and population-dependent differences.
records.limitations: Zone definitions, quantification methods and intervention duration varied considerably.

records.title_en: Polarized training is not universally superior
records.title_zh: 极化训练并非普遍最优
records.population: Endurance-trained adults and young adults.
records.summary_zh: 部分汇总结果显示极化训练对 VO2peak 有小幅优势，但计时表现等结果并未一致更好；更新的个体数据分析也没有发现对金字塔训练的普遍优势。
records.technical_summary_en: A small VO2peak benefit appeared in one meta-analysis, while time-trial outcomes were similar and IPD comparisons found no universal polarized advantage.
records.limitations: Evidence is sensitive to athlete level, intervention length and how intensity zones are counted.

records.title_en: Training level can modify intensity-distribution response
records.title_zh: 训练水平可能影响强度分布反应
records.population: Recreational and competitive endurance athletes.
records.summary_zh: 个体数据 Meta 分析提示，竞技水平运动员和大众耐力运动者对极化与金字塔分布的反应可能不同，因此不能直接复制精英运动员的训练比例。
records.technical_summary_en: Subgroup response differed by performance level, with possible relative benefits of polarized training in competitive and pyramidal training in recreational athletes.
records.limitations: The subgroup finding is not a personal matching algorithm and women were underrepresented.

records.title_en: A taper reduces volume without removing all intensity
records.title_zh: 减量期降低训练量，但不等于完全停练
records.population: Endurance athletes before performance tests or competition.
records.summary_zh: 赛前减量的核心通常是降低累积训练量，同时保留一定强度与专项感觉，以减少疲劳而不是完全停止刺激。具体幅度和时长仍需结合个人与项目。
records.technical_summary_en: Pooled endurance studies associated volume-reduced tapers that maintained intensity with improved time-trial and time-to-exhaustion outcomes.
records.limitations: Subgroup prescriptions were based on few heterogeneous studies and should not be treated as exact personal formulas.

records.title_en: Internal and external load answer different questions
records.title_zh: 内部负荷与外部负荷回答不同问题
records.population: Athletes and recreational users with repeated training records.
records.summary_zh: 外部负荷描述完成了什么，例如时间、距离、重量和次数；内部负荷描述身体如何响应，例如 RPE。二者不能互相替代。
records.technical_summary_en: Consensus monitoring frameworks distinguish completed external work from psychophysiological internal response and recommend context-specific measurement.
records.limitations: Neither category provides a universal total-stress or injury-risk number.

records.title_en: Monitoring supports review, not deterministic prediction
records.title_zh: 训练监控用于复盘，不是确定性预测
records.population: Athletes and recreational exercisers tracked over time.
records.summary_zh: 连续记录能帮助发现训练暴露、完成情况和主观反应的变化，但不能从一个比值或一次异常自动推导伤病、状态或下一周的唯一正确剂量。
records.technical_summary_en: Monitoring frameworks support contextual decision review but do not validate deterministic personal prediction from a single metric.
records.limitations: SportRX has no validated injury-prediction or recovery-scoring model.

records.title_en: Recovery is multidimensional and individual
records.title_zh: 恢复是多维且个体化的
records.population: Athletes and recreational exercisers.
records.summary_zh: 恢复同时受到训练、比赛、工作生活压力和个体反应影响。一次 RPE、一次心率或一个问卷分数都不能完整代表恢复状态。
records.technical_summary_en: The consensus frames recovery as a dynamic, multidimensional process with substantial intra- and inter-individual variability.
records.limitations: The framework does not validate a single recovery score or threshold for SportRX.

records.title_en: Overtraining syndrome is not an app score
records.title_zh: 过度训练综合征不是一个 App 分数
records.population: Athletes with persistent unexplained fatigue and performance decline.
records.summary_zh: 过度训练综合征需要排除疾病、营养不足等其他原因，没有单一可靠指标。SportRX 只能提示持续异常需要专业评估，不能作诊断。
records.technical_summary_en: The joint consensus describes overtraining syndrome as a prolonged maladaptation requiring exclusion of alternative causes; no single marker meets accepted diagnostic criteria.
records.limitations: This research-only card cannot provide diagnosis, medical clearance or treatment advice.

records.title_en: Stretch training can improve range of motion
records.title_zh: 拉伸训练可以改善关节活动范围
records.population: Healthy adults in acute and chronic stretching studies.
records.summary_zh: 单次和持续静态拉伸都可以提高测得的关节活动范围，长期训练后的变化通常更有实际意义。但活动范围增加不等于自动降低伤病或治疗疼痛。
records.technical_summary_en: Meta-analyses found moderate acute and chronic range-of-motion improvements after stretching in healthy adults.
records.limitations: Range-of-motion outcomes do not establish injury prevention, pain relief or sport-performance effects.

records.title_en: Stretching dose plateaus are group estimates
records.title_zh: 拉伸剂量平台是群体估计，不是个人上限
records.population: Adults represented across many joints and stretching protocols.
records.summary_zh: Meta 回归提示单次约 4 分钟、长期每周约 10 分钟后，平均柔韧性收益没有继续明显增加。但这不是每个关节和每个人的精确处方。
records.technical_summary_en: Pooled dose-response models suggested no additional average flexibility benefit beyond about four minutes acutely or ten minutes weekly chronically.
records.limitations: These are heterogeneous group estimates and do not define safe intensity or an individual ceiling.

records.title_en: Plyometrics target jump and sprint qualities
records.title_zh: 增强式训练主要针对跳跃与冲刺能力
records.population: Healthy recreationally active adults and athletes.
records.summary_zh: 持续 4 到 12 周的下肢增强式训练可平均改善跳跃、冲刺和下肢力量。它是针对爆发能力的训练工具，不是所有新手都应直接加入的通用模块。
records.technical_summary_en: Twenty-five studies showed small-to-moderate pooled improvements in jump, sprint and lower-body strength outcomes.
records.limitations: Protocols varied and the review did not validate beginner screening, landing competence or progression rules.

records.title_en: Intervals and continuous training can both build aerobic fitness
records.title_zh: 间歇训练与持续训练都能提升有氧适能
records.population: Healthy young-to-middle-aged adults across varied aerobic protocols.
records.summary_zh: HIIT 和中等强度持续训练都能改善心肺适能。HIIT 在一些研究中平均增益更大或更省时间，但更高强度并不自动更适合每个人。
records.technical_summary_en: Both modes improved VO2max; some pooled comparisons favored interval training, with substantial protocol and population heterogeneity.
records.limitations: Comparative efficacy does not establish individual safety, adherence or the correct interval dose.

records.title_en: Interval training evidence includes older adults, with boundaries
records.title_zh: 中老年人也有间歇训练证据，但边界明确
records.population: Middle-aged and older adults in short exercise interventions.
records.summary_zh: 中老年研究中，间歇与持续训练都提高了心肺适能，间歇训练的平均提升略大。但这不能替代筛查、适应过程和强度耐受评估。
records.technical_summary_en: Fourteen studies reported fitness gains with both modes and a modest pooled VO2max advantage for interval training.
records.limitations: The evidence base was small and short-term and cannot bypass individual safety assessment.

records.title_en: Maintenance and development are different training goals
records.title_zh: 维持期与发展期是不同训练目标
records.population: Previously trained adults facing temporary reductions in training availability.
records.summary_zh: 时间紧张时，可以把目标从继续提高改为暂时维持，并明显减少频率或训练量，同时保留一定强度。维持所需剂量不能当成新手起始量，也不能承诺继续进步。
records.technical_summary_en: A narrative synthesis suggests some endurance and strength adaptations can be maintained temporarily despite large volume or frequency reductions when intensity is preserved.
records.limitations: Direct evidence is limited and does not establish universal minima, especially for athletes and older adults.
